blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Express as a trigonometric function of an angle of positive degree measure of less than \(45^{\circ}\): \(\cos 168^{\circ}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein value nahi nikalni, balke ratio ko aise angle mein likhna hai jo \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan ho.
Diya kya hai? Ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Wohi ratio (ya us ka co-ratio) chhote angle ke saath, sahi sign ke saath.
Plan: \(168^{\circ}\) \(180^{\circ}\) ke qareeb hai, is liye \(180^{\circ} - 12^{\circ}\) likhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos 168^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: isi value ko \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan wale angle mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Angle ko \(180^{\circ}\) ke qareeb likhein
\[168^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} - 12^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(168^{\circ}\) aur \(180^{\circ}\) ka farq sirf \(12^{\circ}\) hai, jo \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota hai. Agar \(90^{\circ} + 78^{\circ}\) likhte to \(78^{\circ}\) bachta, jo shart poori nahi karta.

Allied angle ka rule lagayein
\[\cos 168^{\circ} = \cos(180^{\circ} - 12^{\circ})\]
\[= -\cos 12^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ}\) \(90^{\circ}\) ka even multiple hai, is liye cos cos hi raha (co-ratio nahi bana). \(168^{\circ}\) quadrant II mein hai, jahan sirf sin positive hai, is liye cos ke saath minus aaya.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos 168^{\circ} \approx -0.978\]
\[-\cos 12^{\circ} \approx -0.978 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Sirf tasdeeq ke liye calculator se dono values milayi; barabar hain. Exam mein yeh qadam zaroori nahi, magar ghar par practice ke waqt sign ki ghalti pakarne ka acha tareeqa hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Express as a trigonometric function of an angle of positive degree measure of less than \(45^{\circ}\): \(\sin 192^{\circ}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein value nahi nikalni, balke ratio ko aise angle mein likhna hai jo \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan ho.
Diya kya hai? Ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Wohi ratio (ya us ka co-ratio) chhote angle ke saath, sahi sign ke saath.
Plan: \(192^{\circ}\) \(180^{\circ}\) se thora aage hai, is liye \(180^{\circ} + 12^{\circ}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin 192^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: isi value ko \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan wale angle mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Angle ko \(180^{\circ}\) ke qareeb likhein
\[192^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} + 12^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(192 - 180 = 12\), aur \(12^{\circ}\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota hai, bilkul wohi jo sawal maang raha hai.

Allied angle ka rule lagayein
\[\sin 192^{\circ} = \sin(180^{\circ} + 12^{\circ})\]
\[= -\sin 12^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ}\) even multiple hai, is liye sin sin hi raha. \(192^{\circ}\) quadrant III mein hai jahan sirf tan positive hai; sin negative, is liye minus.
Dhyan dein: \(180^{\circ} + \theta\) mein sin ka sign minus hota hai, \(180^{\circ} - \theta\) mein plus. Sign ko formula se ratne ke bajaye quadrant dekh kar tay karein.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin 192^{\circ} \approx -0.208\]
\[-\sin 12^{\circ} \approx -0.208 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono taraf ki value ek jaisi hai, is liye sign aur angle dono sahi hain.

Plan: \(333^{\circ}\) \(360^{\circ}\) ke qareeb hai, is liye \(360^{\circ} - 27^{\circ}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos 333^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: isi value ko \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan wale angle mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Angle ko \(360^{\circ}\) ke qareeb likhein
\[333^{\circ} = 360^{\circ} - 27^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(360 - 333 = 27\), aur \(27^{\circ} < 45^{\circ}\). \(270^{\circ} + 63^{\circ}\) likhte to \(63^{\circ}\) bachta, jo bara hai.

\[\cos 333^{\circ} = \cos(360^{\circ} - 27^{\circ})\]
\[= \cos 27^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(360^{\circ}\) even multiple hai, cos cos hi raha. \(333^{\circ}\) quadrant IV mein hai, aur quadrant IV mein cos hi woh ratio hai jo positive hota hai. Is liye koi minus nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos 333^{\circ} \approx 0.891\]
\[\cos 27^{\circ} \approx 0.891 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono values barabar hain.

Plan: \(180^{\circ} + 33^{\circ}\) likhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\tan 213^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: isi value ko \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan wale angle mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Angle ko \(180^{\circ}\) ke qareeb likhein
\[213^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} + 33^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(213 - 180 = 33\), aur \(33^{\circ} < 45^{\circ}\).

\[= \tan 33^{\circ}\]

\[\tan 213^{\circ} \approx 0.649\]
\[\tan 33^{\circ} \approx 0.649 \;\checkmark\]

blocks.prompt: 2 (v) Express as a trigonometric function of an angle of positive degree measure of less than \(45^{\circ}\): \(\cos(-435^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein value nahi nikalni, balke ratio ko aise angle mein likhna hai jo \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan ho.
Diya kya hai? Ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Wohi ratio (ya us ka co-ratio) chhote angle ke saath, sahi sign ke saath.
Plan: pehle minus aur chakkar hatayenge, phir \(90^{\circ} - 15^{\circ}\), jahan cos badal kar sin ban jayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos(-435^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: isi value ko \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan wale angle mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Minus sign aur ek chakkar hatayein
\[\cos(-435^{\circ}) = \cos 435^{\circ}\]
\[= \cos(435^{\circ} - 360^{\circ}) = \cos 75^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Cos even hai, is liye minus hat gaya. Phir ek chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) hataya, \(435 - 360 = 75\).

Angle ko \(45^{\circ}\) se neeche layein
\[\cos 75^{\circ} = \cos(90^{\circ} - 15^{\circ})\]
\[= \sin 15^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(75^{\circ}\) abhi bhi \(45^{\circ}\) se bara hai, is liye yahan ruk nahi sakte. \(75^{\circ} = 90^{\circ} - 15^{\circ}\) likha. \(90^{\circ}\) odd multiple hai, is liye cos badal kar sin (co-ratio) ban gaya. \(75^{\circ}\) quadrant I mein hai, sab positive.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 75^{\circ}\) par ruk jana is sawal ki sab se aam ghalti hai; shart \(45^{\circ}\) se kam ki hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos 75^{\circ} \approx 0.259\]
\[\sin 15^{\circ} \approx 0.259 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Complementary angles (jin ka jama \(90^{\circ}\) ho) mein ek ka cos doosre ka sin hota hai. \(75 + 15 = 90\), is liye dono barabar hain.

Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Angle ko \(180^{\circ}\) ke qareeb likhein
\[219^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} + 39^{\circ}\]

blocks.prompt: 2 (vii) Express as a trigonometric function of an angle of positive degree measure of less than \(45^{\circ}\): \(\tan(-597^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein value nahi nikalni, balke ratio ko aise angle mein likhna hai jo \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan ho.
Diya kya hai? Ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Wohi ratio (ya us ka co-ratio) chhote angle ke saath, sahi sign ke saath.
Plan: minus bahar, ek chakkar hatana, phir \(270^{\circ} - 33^{\circ}\), jahan tan badal kar cot ban jayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\tan(-597^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: isi value ko \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan wale angle mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Minus sign bahar aur ek chakkar hatayein
\[\tan(-597^{\circ}) = -\tan 597^{\circ}\]
\[= -\tan(597^{\circ} - 360^{\circ}) = -\tan 237^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Tan odd hai, is liye minus bahar aa gaya aur aakhir tak saath rahega. Phir ek chakkar hataya: \(597 - 360 = 237\).

Angle ko \(45^{\circ}\) se neeche layein
\[\tan 237^{\circ} = \tan(270^{\circ} - 33^{\circ})\]
\[= \cot 33^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(237^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} + 57^{\circ}\) likhte to \(57^{\circ}\) bachta, jo \(45^{\circ}\) se bara hai. Is liye \(270^{\circ}\) se naapa: \(270 - 237 = 33\). \(270^{\circ}\) odd multiple hai (\(3 \times 90^{\circ}\)), is liye tan badal kar cot ban gaya. \(237^{\circ}\) quadrant III mein hai jahan tan positive hai, is liye yahan koi naya minus nahi.

Minus sign wapas lagayein
\[\tan(-597^{\circ}) = -\cot 33^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Step 2 wala minus abhi baqi hai, aur koi doosra minus nahi jo usay cancel kare. Is liye jawab negative hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan(-597^{\circ}) \approx -1.540\]
\[-\cot 33^{\circ} \approx -1.540 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono values barabar hain. \(\tan 57^{\circ} = \cot 33^{\circ}\) bhi hai, kyunke \(57 + 33 = 90\); is liye \(57^{\circ}\) wala rasta bhi isi jawab tak le jata.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein part (vii) ka jawab \(\cot 33^{\circ}\) likha hai, minus sign ke baghair. Yeh ghalat hai: tan odd hai, is liye \(\tan(-597^{\circ}) = -\tan 237^{\circ}\), aur \(\tan 237^{\circ} = \cot 33^{\circ}\) positive hai. Sahi jawab \(-\cot 33^{\circ}\) hai. Sabaq: answer key par andha bharosa na karein; quadrant aur sign khud check karein.

blocks.prompt: 2 (viii) Express as a trigonometric function of an angle of positive degree measure of less than \(45^{\circ}\): \(\cos(-111^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein value nahi nikalni, balke ratio ko aise angle mein likhna hai jo \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan ho.
Diya kya hai? Ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Wohi ratio (ya us ka co-ratio) chhote angle ke saath, sahi sign ke saath.
Plan: minus hatana, phir \(90^{\circ} + 21^{\circ}\), jahan cos badal kar sin ban jayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos(-111^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: isi value ko \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan wale angle mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Minus sign hatayein
\[\cos(-111^{\circ}) = \cos 111^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Cos even hai; minus ka koi asar nahi.

Angle ko \(45^{\circ}\) se neeche layein
\[\cos 111^{\circ} = \cos(90^{\circ} + 21^{\circ})\]
\[= -\sin 21^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ} - 69^{\circ}\) likhte to \(69^{\circ}\) bachta, jo bara hai; is liye \(90^{\circ} + 21^{\circ}\) chuna. \(90^{\circ}\) odd multiple hai, cos badal kar sin ban gaya. Sign ke liye asal angle \(111^{\circ}\) dekhein: quadrant II, jahan cos negative hai. Is liye minus.
Dhyan dein: ratio badalne ke baad bhi sign asal ratio (cos) ka hi dekha jata hai, naye ratio (sin) ka nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos 111^{\circ} \approx -0.358\]
\[-\sin 21^{\circ} \approx -0.358 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono values barabar hain.

blocks.text: Answer key mein part (viii) ka jawab \(\sin 21^{\circ}\) likha hai, minus sign ke baghair. Yeh ghalat hai: \(\cos(-111^{\circ}) = \cos 111^{\circ}\), aur \(111^{\circ}\) quadrant II mein hai jahan cos negative hota hai. Sahi jawab \(-\sin 21^{\circ}\) hai. blocks.prompt: 2 (ix) Express as a trigonometric function of an angle of positive degree measure of less than \(45^{\circ}\): \(\sin(-390^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein value nahi nikalni, balke ratio ko aise angle mein likhna hai jo \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan ho.
Diya kya hai? Ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Wohi ratio (ya us ka co-ratio) chhote angle ke saath, sahi sign ke saath.
Plan: minus bahar aur ek chakkar hatana; bas.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin(-390^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: isi value ko \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan wale angle mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Angle ko \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) (ratio wohi rehta hai) ya \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\) (ratio co-ratio mein badal jata hai) ki shakal mein likhenge, aur woh shakal chunenge jis mein \(\theta\) \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota bache. Sign hamesha asal angle ke quadrant se aata hai.

Minus sign bahar nikalein
\[\sin(-390^{\circ}) = -\sin 390^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Sin odd hai, \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\). Minus bahar aa gaya.

Ek chakkar hatayein
\[-\sin 390^{\circ} = -\sin(360^{\circ} + 30^{\circ})\]
\[= -\sin 30^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(390 - 360 = 30\), aur \(30^{\circ}\) pehle hi \(45^{\circ}\) se chhota hai. \(360^{\circ}\) jorne se ratio aur sign kuch nahi badalta, is liye bahar wala minus hi jawab ka sign hai.

Tasdeeq
\[-390^{\circ} + 360^{\circ} = -30^{\circ}\]
\[\sin(-30^{\circ}) = -\sin 30^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Negative angle mein seedha ek chakkar jorne se bhi wohi jawab aaya. Is ki value \(-\frac{1}{2}\) hai, magar sawal sirf chhote angle ka function maangta hai.

blocks.text: Answer key mein part (ix) ka jawab \(\sin 30^{\circ}\) likha hai, minus sign ke baghair. Yeh ghalat hai: sin odd hai, is liye \(\sin(-390^{\circ}) = -\sin 390^{\circ} = -\sin 30^{\circ}\). Sahi jawab \(-\sin 30^{\circ}\) hai.
